name: Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Kyphoscoliotic Type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Beighton et al. 1998 Diagnostic Criteria for EDS Kyphoscoliotic Type

criteria.description: Congenital muscle hypotonia present at birth
Progressive kyphoscoliosis apparent in early childhood
Generalized joint hypermobility with joint laxity
Elevated urinary lysyl pyridinoline to hydroxylysyl pyridinoline ratio
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in PLOD1 gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital muscle hypotonia, progressive kyphoscoliosis, generalized joint laxity, and biallelic PLOD1 mutations or elevated urinary pyridinoline ratio
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular genetic testing is confirmatory; biochemical testing of urinary pyridinoline crosslinks supports diagnosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Present at birth, leading to delayed motor milestones
Severe spinal curvature developing in infancy or early childhood

pathognomonic.symptomName: Generalized joint hypermobility with joint laxity
pathognomonic.notes: Marked joint instability and frequent dislocations

common.notes: Soft, velvety, and easily stretched skin
Skin tears and bruises with minimal trauma
Due to hypotonia and joint laxity

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory insufficiency due to severe scoliosis
occasional.notes: Restrictive lung disease secondary to spinal deformity
Reduced bone density increasing fracture risk
Fragile teeth and early periodontal disease

rare.notes: Due to connective tissue fragility in lungs

laboratory: Elevated urinary lysyl pyridinoline to hydroxylysyl pyridinoline ratio
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in PLOD1 gene
other: Beighton score demonstrating generalized joint hypermobility

distinguishingFeatures: Skin hyperextensibility and atrophic scarring more prominent
Ectopia lentis and aortic root dilation common
Severe joint hypermobility with congenital bilateral hip dislocation

redFlags: Severe muscle hypotonia with respiratory compromise
references: Beighton P, et al. Ehlers-Danlos syndromes: revised nosology, Villefranche, 1997. Am J Med Genet. 1998.
Malfait F, et al. The 2017 international classification of the Ehlers-Danlos syndromes. Am J Med Genet C Semin Med Genet. 2017.
Syx D, et al. Kyphoscoliotic Ehlers-Danlos syndrome: clinical and molecular insights. Am J Med Genet C Semin Med Genet. 2015.
